card.name: Spaces before a dose after a drug name
card.fires_on: Mostly the space right after a drug name in combination-dosing text, just before the partner drug's dose number. Also fires inside long drug names and web addresses.

modes.label: Space before partner dose
modes.description: A blank space after a drug name in a combination regimen, right before a mg or mg/kg amount.
modes.example: Administer KEYTRUDA QLEX in combination with lenvatinib<< >>20 mg orally once daily.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: The last piece of a long multi-drug name, such as an antiviral combination.
modes.example: . Darolutamide Do not exceed 5 mg once daily. Additional Antiviral Medications Simeprevir Dasabuvir/ombitas<<vir>>

modes.label: End of web address
modes.description: The final piece of a URL path given in the label text.
modes.example: The reader training can be accessed here: https://www.neuraceqreadertraining.com/<<learn>>.

card.writes: It pushes up single capital letters such as B, Z, D and C, and suppresses odd code-like fragments, so the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the gap after a drug name just before the dose of the drug it is combined with.
